response.justification: The candidate is a strong, experienced full-stack and systems developer with impressive breadth (web, embedded, low-latency, DLang, C/C++), but the role requires native Japanese fluency, deep Linux kernel modification experience, and specific embedded network security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips) — none of which appear in the resume. Japanese language is a hard requirement and is entirely absent, making this a fundamental disqualifier regardless of technical strengths.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across multiple domains including embedded C/C++ work at National Instruments
Demonstrated systems-level and low-latency programming experience (DLang, async I/O, fibers, high-performance databases)
Strong track record of ownership, cross-team collaboration, and technical leadership across many companies and projects
concerns: No mention of Japanese language proficiency, which is a mandatory requirement for this role
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation/modification experience or embedded network security domain knowledge (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips)
Career trajectory is heavily web/full-stack focused in recent years (Node.js, TypeScript, React), a significant drift from embedded/security firmware work

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded network security domain experience
Strong general software engineering and C/embedded background
